name: Gazzew Boba U4
description: Silent tactile with a round, pronounced bump at the top of the stroke and removable silicone dampening pads seated on the stem at both top-out and bottom-out. The nylon housing produces a muted thud rather than a clack; popular in office environments. Comes lubed at the leaf and spring bottom; slide rails ship dry. Builders often rattle-mod the spring for a cleaner sound.
